# Ferronyx

> Ferronyx is the intelligence layer for ROS2 robots in production. Real-time observability, AI-assisted debugging, and fleet-wide diagnostics. Reduces robot MTTR from hours to minutes.

Ferronyx helps robotics teams monitor, debug, and fix their robot fleets. Key capabilities include real-time ROS2 topic monitoring, AI-powered root cause analysis, sensor drift detection, navigation failure debugging, and deployment correlation tracking.

## Core Features

- [Real-time Fleet Dashboard](https://ferronyx.com): Monitor all robots in one view
- [AI Root Cause Analysis](https://ferronyx.com/use-cases): Automatically identify failure causes
- [Alert Correlation](https://ferronyx.com/blog/intelligent-alert-correlation-root-cause-analysis): Group related alerts, find root cause
- [GPU Monitoring](https://ferronyx.com/blog/gpu-monitoring-optimization-insights): Per-GPU metrics beyond averages
- [OTA Deployment Tracking](https://ferronyx.com/blog/ota-deployment-tracking-failure-correlation): Correlate deployments with failures

## Use Cases

- [Reduce MTTR](https://ferronyx.com/use-cases): Debug robots in minutes, not hours
- [Sensor Drift Detection](https://ferronyx.com/use-cases): Catch sensor degradation early
- [Navigation Debugging](https://ferronyx.com/use-cases): Fix Nav2 failures faster
- [Fleet Visibility](https://ferronyx.com/use-cases): See all robots at once
